Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the birth county of J. P. Hayes. While WebSurfer correctly established that J. P. Hayes was born in Appleton, Wisconsin, the Planner erroneously concluded that Appleton is in "Outagamie County" without verifying this fact. In reality, Appleton is the county seat of **Winnebago County**, not Outagamie County. This fundamental geographical error cascaded through the entire conversation, leading the Planner to search for bordering counties of the wrong county (Outagamie) and ultimately providing an incorrect answer (Green Bay, the seat of Brown County, which borders Outagamie, not Winnebago). The error occurred at Step 2 when the Planner first synthesized the WebSurfer's finding into a specific county name without external verification.
